'''Matt Moseley''' (forum handle '''LtPage2''') co-founded [[Holotable]] with [[Rustan Sharer]] in September 2004 and was its sole developer.<ref name="htabout2012" /> He is named as copyright holder on the [[Holotable]] readme for 2004&ndash;2007.<ref name="readme">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071123231323/http://www.holotable.com/readme.php Holotable readme], holotable.com (Wayback, 23 November 2007). Copyright 2004&ndash;2007 Matt Moseley.</ref> A 2 December 2014 Holotable news post is signed Matt.<ref name="ht2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141217162132/http://www.holotable.com/ holotable.com homepage], Wayback 17 December 2014. News dated 12/2/14.</ref>

In February 2004, in a Players Committee forum thread on Georgia tournaments, he voted for the [[Classic]] format, the only one he had decks for.<ref name="pcf-2224-41311">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41311#41311 Georgia Tourneys], Matt Moseley, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318153120/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40240%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 16 June 2006 he wrote that the Holotable game servers and website were back up after the server machine had been down for most of the week, and that CDFs with the errata'd cards and a new version of Holotable would follow that weekend.<ref name="pcf-10238-141734">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141734#141734 Game play Satisfaction], Matt Moseley, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618114305/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10238&view=next Internet Archive]</ref>
